At the time the action is taken, "antigenablocked": "true" is added to the connection entry. patterns.description: Total unique connections, events or activity that contribute to the overall understanding of your digital environment over the last 12 weeks.

AzureActiveDirectory.description: The number of active user entities in the last seven days observed for this platform.

total.description: The number of active devices created for users observed by the Darktrace system in external platforms.

licenseIPCount.description: The peak value of the number of distinct internal (not excluded) IP addresses seen within any 24 hour period over the last seven days. Does not overlap with licenseCloudIPCount .

licenseCloudIPCount.description: The peak value of the number of distinct internal (not excluded) IP addresses seen in a cloud VLAN within any 24 hour period over the last seven days. IP addresses will be located in cloud VLANs if created from Darktrace ⁄ CLOUD flow log ingestion, or created from traffic observed by a compatible Darktrace vSensor. Does not overlap with licenseIPCount .

totalOther.description: The total number of active devices performing other operations seen by the Darktrace system in the last seven days.

totalCount.description: For each tactic, the number of events that were relevant to the type of activity the tactic encompasses - and therefore were evaluated by the Darktrace model engine - over the time period.. modelEstimate.description: The estimated number of model alerts that would be created for models relevant to this MITRE ATT&CK tactic if Darktrace AI-powered analysis was not taken into account by the modeling engine.

modelCount.description: Darktrace default models are mapped to relevant MITRE ATT&CK Framework techniques and tactics. For each tactic, the number of model alerts triggered for mapped models over the time period.

mitreTactics.description: An array of MITRE ATT&CK Framework tactics and events and model alerts relevant to those tactics over the time period.

modelCount.description: The total count of model alert events over the time period.

startTime.description: The starttime in epoch time for the time window statistics are calculated over. This is approximately 28 days in the majority of cases.

totalCount.description: The total number of raw events that were passed to Darktrace modeling for further investigation over the last 28 days.
